_README: The executor vehicle's model, effort and fallback as a project setting, read by the kit's vehicle-settings readers into one posture, which the placed executor's body follows: the agents writer derives it from model and effort, the upgrade reports a differing body as pending, and fallback names the model of the one retry; seeded once and never clobbered, hand-edited as three bare tokens with fallback differing from model. The optional review-lens section holds the bundled review lens's model and effort, opus and high by default: the agents writer derives the placed review-lens.md from them and re-derives a differing copy. Naming a lane in the lanes array of the judge object of docs/ai/vehicles.json consents to sending that lane's content to the judge bridge's vendor whenever a kit step of that lane runs, and to nothing else. To name a lane, add the optional judge object, "judge": { "lanes": ["gate-triage"] }; each lane and the content it sends: gate-triage: the raw failing output a gate run printed. Retention as the vendor states it: zero data retention for enterprise customers only; a data processing agreement covers retention; a commitment not to train on user data.
